notes.people: Counts are people, on the date of their first event: a person who replies twice counts once.
notes.before: A reply in these dates can come from a person contacted before them.
notes.positiveBefore: A positive reply in these dates can come from a person who had already replied before them.
notes.unknown: Unknown means not measured yet: Zenbree does not record its own bounces yet, and meetings and deals will come from HubSpot.
notes.variants: In an A/B test, Zenbree picks no winner and shows no percentages: a variant can hold few people, and a small gap can be chance.
notes.variantGroups: Outside the test: people who joined while the test was paused, who get the copy of variant A. Not attributed: messages and replies of people no longer in the campaign, or of senders who matched nobody.
notes.instantlyPartial: Instantly counts are complete up to {at}.
notes.instantlyPending: Instantly counts are not complete yet: the first full read of Instantly has not finished.
